scripts.build: bun --cwd ../app build && cargo build --target aarch64-apple-ios --release && mkdir -p gen/apple/Externals/arm64/release gen/apple/Externals/arm64/debug && cp target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libcoursedeck_ipad_lib.a gen/apple/Externals/arm64/release/libapp.a && cp target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libcoursedeck_ipad_lib.a gen/apple/Externals/arm64/debug/libapp.a && rm -rf gen/apple/assets/* && cp -R ../app/build/* gen/apple/assets/
scripts.build:svelte: bun --cwd ../app build && rm -rf gen/apple/assets/* && cp -R ../app/build/* gen/apple/assets/
scripts.build:rust: cargo build --target aarch64-apple-ios --release && mkdir -p gen/apple/Externals/arm64/release gen/apple/Externals/arm64/debug && cp target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libcoursedeck_ipad_lib.a gen/apple/Externals/arm64/release/libapp.a && cp target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libcoursedeck_ipad_lib.a gen/apple/Externals/arm64/debug/libapp.a
scripts.open: bun run build && bun run xcode
scripts.install:xspot: bun run build && xcodebuild -project gen/apple/coursedeck-ipad.xcodeproj -scheme coursedeck-ipad_iOS -configuration release -destination 'id=a0db1cb93df7b788df78d121301d97c4ba6c2888' -allowProvisioningUpdates build && ios-deploy -i a0db1cb93df7b788df78d121301d97c4ba6c2888 -b $(xcodebuild -project gen/apple/coursedeck-ipad.xcodeproj -scheme coursedeck-ipad_iOS -configuration release -showBuildSettings | grep -m 1 'TARGET_BUILD_DIR =' | awk '{print $3}')/CourseDeck.app
